# Michael's Corner

> Free AI prompts, browser tools and apps from Michael Florian, who is not a developer and has a normal day job. 64 prompts in 8 packs, 7 tools that run entirely in the browser with no account, and 5 finished apps. Nothing is behind a signup form and there are no affiliate links anywhere on the site. Last updated 2026-09-07.

The position is anti-hype: the first rough version out of a model takes minutes and feels like magic, then the checking and fixing takes hours, and almost nobody says that part out loud. Everything here is written for someone who wants to use AI themselves rather than hire anyone.

## Pages

- [Michael's Corner](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/): Free AI prompts, browser tools and apps from Michael Florian, who is not a developer. 64 prompts in 8 packs, 7 tools that run entirely in your browser, 5 finished apps. No signup and no email gate.
- [Your first hour with AI](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/start.html): A 7-point checklist and a 5-step guide for your first hour with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. One real task from your own week, no theory, free to work through.
- [Steal these prompts](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/library.html): 64 free prompts in 8 packs for ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, sorted by who they are for: beginners, writing, building software, founders, freelancers, office work, creators and students.
- [Most useful AI tools](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools.html): 7 free AI tools that run in your browser with no signup: an AI cost calculator, a context-window checker, a subscription versus API breakeven, an automation scorecard, an AI-slop detector, a prompt tightener and a difficult-email builder.
- [Apps I built](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/bill.html): 5 apps built with AI in the evenings: Tuck and Frost for Chrome, Recall and Refill for macOS, and Cropper, a local video editor. All finished, all in daily use.
- [Watch and learn](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/channel.html): Videos of real AI builds with the dead ends left in, sorted into building with AI, for beginners, prompting and behind the build. Filming now.
- [Who I am](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/about.html): Michael Florian. Not a developer, with a normal day job and more than twenty finished projects built with AI in the evenings. What he got good at, and what he did not.
- [Michael's AI Starter Kit](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/kit.html): Six free things for anyone starting with AI this week: 10 reusable prompts, a plain-words model guide, a first-hour walkthrough, a cost cheat sheet, an is-this-an-AI-job checklist and the fix-it lines. Listed in full before you give an email.

## Free browser tools

Seven calculators and checkers. Each runs entirely in the visitor's browser, computes a real number rather than a canned one, and needs no account.

- [AI cost calculator](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/ai-cost-calculator.html): What a month of AI actually costs, on rates you can edit. Drag three sliders and the number is computed on the page.
- [AI-slop detector](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/ai-slop-detector.html): Paste any text and a public rule list counts the AI tells and stamps a score, with every flagged line shown.
- [Difficult-email prompt builder](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/difficult-email-prompt-assembler.html): Six questions about the email you dread, then a copy-ready prompt with your facts and hard lines in it.
- [Fits-in-context checker](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/fits-in-context.html): Whether your document fits a model's context window or needs splitting, across five window sizes.
- [Prompt tightener](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/prompt-tightener.html): Strips the filler it can prove is filler and flags the vague asks it cannot fix. Deletion only, never a rewrite.
- [Should you automate it?](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/should-you-automate.html): Six questions about a task, one verdict: automate now, assist only, or leave it human. The weights are published.
- [Subscription vs API breakeven](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/tools/subscription-vs-api.html): Your usage against both prices, and the point where one becomes cheaper than the other.

## Prompt packs

Sixty-four prompts, free to copy, grouped by who they are for. Each prompt has bracketed fill slots and a note on when to use it.

- [Best prompts for beginners](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/beginners.html): Start here. Simple prompts that work on your first day with ChatGPT or Claude.
- [Building software with AI](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/building.html): Go from a rough idea to working software, even if you do not code.
- [Content creators](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/creators.html): Make more from what you already record. Repurpose, script, and publish faster.
- [Founders and small business owners](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/founders.html): For people running a small business. Customers, reviews, numbers, suppliers.
- [Freelancers and solo operators](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/freelancers.html): Your business is you. Briefs, proposals, feedback rounds, unpaid invoices.
- [Office and operations work](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/office.html): Inbox, meetings, reports, spreadsheets. Small routines for the everyday grind.
- [Students and learning](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/students.html): Learn faster and remember more. These make AI quiz you and question you.
- [Best prompts for writing](https://michaels-corner.netlify.app/packs/writing.html): Draft faster and still sound like yourself. These keep your voice and cut the filler.
